skill: M08 回旋尾扫（鳄王、鳄将精英）

parameters.prompt: The exact upright crocodile warrior in the reference performs ONE tail whip attack in place. It plants its feet, twists the upper body and hips to the right to wind up, then swings its thick tail low around in front of it in one wide arc toward screen left while the torso turns with it, then turns back and returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. The tail keeps the same length and never leaves the frame. Exactly two arms, two legs and one tail. Only one swing, no full spin, no turning its back to the camera, no jumping, punching or moving across the frame. Keep the same three-quarter left view, armour, belt and kilt. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, glow, energy, breath, fire, smoke, mist, liquid, spray, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shadow or text.
